sittings.bodyEn: Mandatory if time is short. Listen for calendar, notes, department liaison, or travel. That shapes whether evenings fit.
sittings.mandarin: 这个助理，一天里主要是管老板的日历、写纪要、对接部门，还是跟着出差？

sittings.bodyEn: Mandatory if time is short. Listen whether you report to 丁先生 or the boss. Ask how to address the boss. Ask if 丁先生 is hiring only or your future manager.
sittings.mandarin: 我是向您汇报，还是向老板本人？老板怎么称呼？您这边是招聘，还是我以后的直接上级？

sittings.bodyEn: Mandatory if time is short. Listen if daytime office is required. Ask if evenings and weekends are occasional or fixed weekly. Ask about overtime.
sittings.mandarin: 是不是要求白天坐班？晚上和周末是偶尔，还是每周固定？加班多不多？

sittings.bodyEn: Mandatory if time is short. Listen whether 8–12K is daytime full-time. Ask probation length and how base vs performance split.
sittings.mandarin: 这个范围是白天全职吗？试用期多久？底薪和绩效怎么分？

sittings.bodyEn: Confirm place and time. From Zijingang. Do not invent commute minutes.
sittings.mandarin: 地址确认：杭州市余杭区洋帆中心1幢21楼，今天 18:00，从紫金港过来。

sittings.bodyEn: Title is 总办秘书. Listen whether the real work is secretary, admin, or the boss’s project assistant.
sittings.mandarin: 岗位名叫总办秘书。实际是秘书、行政，还是老板的项目助理？

sittings.bodyEn: Ask where overseas work is now, or if still preparing. Indonesian and English can help. Do not assume Indonesia business already exists.
sittings.mandarin: 海外现在在哪些国家？还是还在准备？印尼语和英语可以帮忙，但不假设已经有印尼业务。

sittings.bodyEn: Ask if you meet the boss next, and roughly when there is a result.
sittings.mandarin: 今天之后，是再见老板本人吗？大概什么时候有结果？

sittings.titleEn: If main work does not fit
sittings.bodyEn: If they say the main work is daytime office, private life, chops, or government reception, say this and do not promise first.
sittings.mandarin: 这部分我和现在的课、也和我做过的事对不上。我不先答应。

sittings.bodyEn: If time is short, the first four questions are mandatory.
sittings.prompt: If time is short, which four questions come first?
choices: Daily work; who you report to; daytime vs evenings; whether pay range is daytime full-time
Patent count; funding; commute minutes; visa type
Boss private finance; chops; government reception; AI rebuild
Only overseas offices and alumni competition letters
